params.prompt: A real aerial photograph taken from exactly the viewpoint of the first attached image: a drone high over farmland looking across the whole small Pacific Northwest town spread out below (its street grid, rooftops, tree-lined streets, fairgrounds, open fields and dark evergreen forest beyond, rolling foothills) to Mount Rainier standing dead centre on the horizon, huge, its glaciers crisp and white; the second attached image shows the real photographic look of the mountain's north face. A clear, dry, bright late-morning in early autumn: no haze, no fog, no blur, every rooftop sharp all the way to the horizon, a deep blue sky with a few small white clouds. Photoreal, full-frame camera, 35 mm, f/8, like a high-quality photograph, never a 3D render or a map; no text of any kind, no titles, no overlays, no logos, no watermark, no people.
